## Mission

The DS Lab is DIAD's transversal team. It builds the data foundations that the three business teams, and other WOAH departments, rely on: data products on Microsoft Fabric, data management and analytics pipelines, process automation and ad-hoc analyses. It also spearheads AI adoption across the Organisation.
